title: Positive Ext classes from free abelian sheaves are killed by presheaf covers
statement: Let $(\mathcal C,J)$ be a site with $\mathcal C:\mathrm{Type}\,u$ and morphisms in $\mathrm{Type}\,v$, admitting sheafification of $v$-small abelian presheaves and $\mathrm{Ext}$ in universe $w$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For a $v$-small presheaf of sets $P$, write $Z[P]=(\mathbb Z[P])^\#$, where $\mathbb Z[P]$ is the objectwise free abelian presheaf and $(-)^\#$ is sheafification. For every abelian sheaf $F$, $q>0$, and $x\in\mathrm{Ext}^q(Z[P],F)$ there are a $v$-small presheaf $E$ and a locally surjective map $f:E\to P$ such that pullback along $Z[f]:Z[E]\to Z[P]$ sends $x$ to zero.

source.place: Tag 06XU (Yoneda representatives), with the generator-lifting construction in the parent node proof step 1, following sites-cohomology.tex Tag 03F9; read at https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/06XU and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/03F9

proof.text: Represent x by a finite degree-q Yoneda extension (Tag 06XU). Let G -> Z[P] be its final epimorphism. For each V form E(V)={(p,g) in P(V) times G(V) | image(g)=generator(p)}. The restriction maps act coordinatewise, and naturality preserves this equality. Thus E is a presheaf in the same value universe.

Projection f:E -> P is locally surjective by local lifting along the epimorphism of abelian sheaves G -> Z[P]. The second projection extends, by the free abelian and sheafification adjunctions, to Z[E] -> G over Z[P]. Hence the last short exact sequence of the Yoneda extension splits after pullback along Z[f]. Its class is zero, and composing with the remaining extension class yields zero. Degree one uses just the split last sequence.

mathlib_searches.query: A positive Ext class from a free abelian sheaf is killed by a locally surjective presheaf map
Vanishing of all presheaf Cech nerve cohomology implies vanishing of higher sheaf cohomology
mathlib_searches.results: Eight hits including Sheaf.cohomologyPresheaf, Sheaf.H, MayerVietorisSquare.shortComplex_exact, and K-injectivity; none states local killing or the presheaf Cech Ext edge injection.
Ext.comp, mk₀_comp_mk₀, comp_zero and the associativity API are available. No local-killing or positive-degree edge injectivity theorem.

Read Mathlib DerivedCategory/Ext/Basic, ExactSequences, EnoughInjectives, EnoughProjectives, Sites/LocallySurjective and EpiMono. No local-killing or presheaf descent edge theorem. WeilConjectures.CategoryTheory.Sites.CechCriterion requires EnoughInjectives, larger coefficient universe and slice finite products. The DAG has no separate node for these two steps.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_presheaf_ext_local_killing
    {C : Type u} [Category.{v} C] {J : GrothendieckTopology C}
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{v}]
    [HasExt.{w'} (Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v})]
    (F : Sheaf J AddCommGrpCat.{v}) (P : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v)
    (q : ℕ) (hq : 0 < q)
    (x : Ext ((presheafToSheaf J AddCommGrpCat).obj (P ⋙ AddCommGrpCat.free)) F q) :
    ∃ (E : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type v) (f : E ⟶ P), Presheaf.IsLocallySurjective J f ∧
      (Ext.mk₀ ((presheafToSheaf J AddCommGrpCat).map
        (Functor.whiskerRight f AddCommGrpCat.free))).comp x (Nat.zero_add q) = 0
